faq.q: What is the origin of Abdulfattah?
faq.a: Abdulfattah is associated with Arabic. Abdulfattah is Arabic عَبْدُ الْفَتَّاح (ʿAbd al-Fattāḥ), meaning 'servant of the Opener'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الْفَتَّاح is Arabic.
